correctness.rationale: All values follow from exhaustive structural cases: total-element distance formulas for rim/spoke/peripheral units; partition into n+1 cliques bounds the color-one class; 2-packing at most n bounds color two; a 4n+1 square-clique of central elements yields the q>=2 lower bound; explicit colorings attain all three regimes and handle n=1. Endpoint-distance comparison and a separate exact branch-and-bound implementation independently check n<=6; constructions checked through n=14 and q in {0,1,2,3,8}. Finite checks are not used as infinite proofs.

originality.rationale: No covering statement was found in targeted searches. The accessible original 2026 abstract reports exact complete-bipartite, path and cycle cases, whereas this theorem gives a three-phase, all-orders friendship-graph formula for a sequence with a variable prefix. The 2025 introduction studies the original packing-total sequence, not this family. published-finding corpus returns graph-square and other windmill-invariant results rather than the same S-packing total parameter. The complete originating preprint is inaccessible, a real residual literature risk rather than evidence of noncoverage.
residual_risks: The full original 2026 preprint and its appendices could not be read; a generic bound or other theorem therein might imply part or all of the formula.
Unindexed equivalent work on mixed-distance colorings of total graph squares could exist.
Secondary summaries of open problems were not taken as definitive evidence of absence of results.

value.rationale: Provides the full n>=1, q>=0 sharp classification for a canonical windmill family beyond the exact families listed in the 2026 introducing work. The transition 4n+1 to 3n+2 to 3n+1 proves that one additional radius-two color saves n-1 labels but a second saves only one, with complete saturation thereafter, explained by geometric distance classes rather than arbitrary numerical slices.
